h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תֵצֵא, ב׳ Ki Seitzei, 2
Releasing the Captive Soul Through Torah and Teshuvah

p: "When you go out to war against your enemy,
and Hashem your God will deliver him into your hand," etc.
'When you go out to war against your enemy'
for we must go out against it
and to wage war against it;
it will be delivered into the hand of the person,
'And Hashem your God will deliver him into your hand.'"
that conquering in the war against the inclination
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמַרְנוּ כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים
based on what we have said several times,
that the Torah is called the Name of Hashem,
for the blessing over the Torah before it,
"When I call the Name of Hashem,
and as is written in the holy Zohar
And this is the meaning of
"And Havayah your God will deliver him":
that is, through words of Torah,
that He is the Master of your powers,
through this you will be able
to conquer the inclination in the future
for the main thing in teshuvah
is abandoning the sin from now on,
and that you know that the Name of Hashem,
which is the words of Torah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א רב, א)
And as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 202a):
And this is what is written
in the Zohar Chadash cited above:
"And Hashem your God will deliver him into your hand,"
drag it to the beis midrash";
and I created Torah as its antidote."
in the same place in the Gemara (Sukkah 52b)
and were it not that HaKadosh Baruch Hu
he could not overcome it, etc."
does not have the power to defeat the yetzer hara,
even while he is occupied with words of Torah;
rather, he needs to pray to Hashem Yisbarach
that the words of Torah enter
But after prayer to Hashem Yisbarach,
if he merits to conquer the yetzer hara,
through the power of the Torah,
which is called the Name of Hashem,
"And Hashem your God will deliver him into your hand";
for indeed "there is no accusing force
And this is the meaning in the Gemara:
"Were it not that HaKadosh Baruch Hu
that is, through words of Torah,
as referring to the yetzer tov,
'and you shall bring her into your house'
from which she was banished, etc."
on the intent of the Tikkunim (Tikkun 6):
גַּם צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת (תְּהִלִּים פד, ד)
"'Even the bird has found a home' (Tehillim 84:4)
and this is the beis of Bereishis,
"Behold, the fear of Hashem, that is wisdom";
and this is the aspect of the lower Shechinah.
And this is what is said in the Introduction:
for it is written on her account (Yeshayahu 56:7):
shall be called a house of prayer'
And through this he will merit
that the words of Torah will enter

p: And the Zohar Chadash says further:
"'And you shall bring her into your house,
and she shall shave her head
that the serpent cast into her."
indicate the excesses of the body;
that he rectify his deeds for the future;
for as long as he has not rectified the past,
that the yetzer hara will not return
rather, he must rectify the past,
against His will, may His Name be blessed.
"And she shall remove the garment of her captivity from upon her"
from the sin of the Calf, etc."
And this applies to every time,
may the memory of the holy tzaddik be blessed:
that what all the sefarim explain,
"When you go out to war against your enemy,"
as referring to the yetzer hara,
is not by way of exposition and allusion alone;
rather, the simple plain meaning is so;
which is called enemy and foe,
and in the Zohar Chadash here).
"And she shall remove the garment of her captivity,"
in the manner of what it says (Zechariah 3:4):
And the Zohar Chadash says further:
"'And she shall weep for her father
and her mother a full month'
this is the month of Elul,
in which Moshe ascended the mountain
similar to what they expounded in the Gemara (Berachos 35b).
'My eyes shed streams of water,' etc."
David HaMelech, peace be upon him:
"My eyes shed streams of water," etc.
until the Day of Atonement, etc."
one merits the attribute of Binah,
the aspect of the supernal Mother,
which is the world of freedom;
from the accusation of the yetzer hara.
to be able to fix from their side
the holiness of Shabbos as well.
corresponds to the holiness of Shabbos,
for there are six festival days
and it corresponds to the Shabbos day;
on the reason for the name of Maseches Yoma.
And this is the matter of
they would immediately be redeemed, etc."
"And Hashem your God will deliver him into your hand";
for the awe of Shabbos is upon the am ha'aretz,
and all of Yisrael are called on Shabbos
and they merit words of Torah,
they merit teshuvah for the future,
"It is good to give thanks (lehodos) to Hashem":
'And one who confesses and forsakes them shall find mercy.'"
"And she shall weep for her father
and her mother a full month,"
And afterward, on the second Shabbos,
enter the depths of the heart;
from the accusation of the yetzer hara,
as is written in the Mechilta
And this is the meaning of
from the accusation of the yetzer hara,
he is the Angel of Death"
along the lines of what is said
in the two chambers of the heart"
to be redeemed immediately and completely.
that if they kept one Shabbos
that is, that right on the first Shabbos
But the Gemara, speaking of the community,
that it is difficult to merit the upper Shabbos
and afterward on the second Shabbos
they can merit the upper Shabbos,
so that they will immediately be redeemed
only that the world is judged according to its majority.
